title: Nutty Korean Shrimp Pasta
description: Salty, bouncy qq, festive Australian dish featuring dried shrimp goong haeng, pasta water emulsion, and a pescatarian-friendly crunch.
instructions: Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente, reserving 1 cup pasta water, then drain.
Heat sesame oil in a large pan over medium heat and add dried shrimp, cooking until they soften and release aroma.
Stir in gochujang, soy sauce, and rice vinegar, letting the mixture simmer for 2 minutes to blend flavors.
Add the drained spaghetti to the pan, tossing it with the sauce and gently stirring to coat.
If the pasta seems dry, pour in a splash of the reserved pasta water, stirring continuously until a silky emulsion forms.
Sprinkle toasted sesame seeds and sliced green onion over the pasta and give one final toss.
Optionally, add a pinch of chili flakes for heat before serving.
Serve hot, garnishing with extra green onion if desired.
